FAQ

AURA questions, answered.

What is AURA?

AURA is an AI sales and support agent for online stores in Dubai and worldwide. It answers shoppers on your website, WhatsApp, Instagram and Telegram, recommends products, shares checkout links, tracks orders and recovers abandoned carts.

Does AURA work with Shopify?

Yes. AURA is built for Shopify stores and reads your products, stock, prices and orders, so its answers are always up to date. WooCommerce and other platforms are supported on request.

Can AURA track orders?

Yes. Shoppers share their order number or phone and AURA replies with the status and tracking link, so your team stops copying tracking numbers by hand.

How does abandoned cart recovery work?

When a shopper leaves items in the cart, AURA sends a friendly WhatsApp reminder, answers any question that stopped them and sends them back to checkout.

Which languages does AURA speak?

Arabic, English and 100+ more. It replies in the language the shopper writes in.

Can my team take over a chat?

Yes. Your team sees every conversation and can step in at any time. AURA hands over complaints and special requests automatically.

How long does setup take?

Setup starts within 24 hours of your kickoff call, and we agree the go-live date with you on that call. We connect your store, train AURA on your catalogue and policies, test it with you and switch it on.

How much does AURA cost?

Starter, Growth and Scale have fixed monthly prices shown on this page, with a one-time setup fee on monthly plans. Annual plans save 15%, with the setup fee fully waived on Starter and 50% off on Growth, Scale and Enterprise. Enterprise is quoted based on your volume and integrations.
